verdict.rationale: Cursor documents launching 'fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days' and running agents across terminal/Slack/GitHub, which supports managing multiple concurrent agent sessions from one workspace. However there's no independent or hands-on corroboration of the actual unified-workspace UI/UX for tracking many parallel sessions, and community comments focus on bugs/pricing rather than this specific workflow. Missing for 10: independent verification of the multi-session management interface, detail on session monitoring/switching mechanics, and engineering-lead-specific oversight features (e.g., team-wide session visibility).
